quote.text: Budi poput krševite obale o koju se neprestance lome valovi. Ona stoji postojano, a oko nje uzavrele vode polako se smiruju.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius, Meditacije
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Like the crumbling shore standing firm, be the unwavering foundation your children can rely on even when life’s storms rage.
    • Embrace each challenge as an opportunity to cultivate calm and resilience, helping your family find stability amid chaos.
  • Leadership:
    • Lead by example; let your steadfast character inspire and calm those who follow you during turbulent times.
    • Understand that through consistent strength and clear vision, you can turn disruptive challenges into opportunities for growth.
  • Product Management:
    • In the fast-paced world of product development, maintain a clear, stable direction to guide your team through rapid changes.
    • Let your calm decisiveness amid market fluctuations reassure stakeholders, gradually turning sudden disruptions into smooth transitions.
